sourceLeaderboard.catalog.source: All {count} catalog and settled sources. Each source has its own row, including sources with no payments.
sourceLeaderboard.catalog.text: 全部 {count} 个目录来源和已结算来源。每个来源单列一行，包括尚无付款的来源。

sourceLeaderboard.feeBoundary.source: Creator rewards go to the creator. Owner fees are Keryx transfers attributed to cited sources; they are not publisher earnings. One transfer may contribute to several rows.
sourceLeaderboard.feeBoundary.text: 创作者奖励支付给创作者。所有者费用是归属于被引用来源的 Keryx 转账，不是发布者收入。一笔转账可能计入多行。

sourceLeaderboard.catalogUnavailable.source: Retained feed catalog unavailable; this list is incomplete.
sourceLeaderboard.catalogUnavailable.text: 留存订阅源目录不可用；此列表不完整。

sourceLeaderboard.feesUnavailable.source: Source fee totals are unavailable: some settlement or public allocation evidence is missing.
sourceLeaderboard.feesUnavailable.text: 来源费用总额不可用：缺少部分结算或公开分配证据。
